messages.content: I just received the Hampton notice about its parking deck being closed that weekend. Before the cancellation deadline, check whether the replacement garage can be entered overnight, what parking will now cost for our stay, and how that compares with Midtown Lodge today.

The public garage at 301 Six Forks Road is open to vehicles and pedestrians 24 hours a day, so your 12:30 to 1:00 a.m. arrival will not be a problem. Hampton guests receive a validated rate of $18 per night. For Saturday morning through Sunday afternoon, that adds $36 to the existing $398.11 reservation, bringing the effective stay total to $434.11. The garage is about two blocks from the hotel.
Does the Hampton still guarantee the room that late, even though we would have to park elsewhere first?

Yes. Confirmation RHM-731946 is still guaranteed for late arrival, and the note still shows an expected arrival between 12:30 and 1:00 a.m. Saturday. The desk is staffed overnight. The parking change does not alter the room reservation or its 6:00 p.m. local cancellation deadline tomorrow.
All right. What is the exact current total at Midtown Lodge, and is its parking actually on site?

Midtown Lodge currently has one refundable room for two adults for November 14-16 at $421.64 total, including taxes and on-site self-parking. Its lot remains accessible overnight, and the front desk can guarantee a post-midnight arrival if the arrival time is added when booking. Free cancellation also ends at 6:00 p.m. local time tomorrow.
So it is $12.47 less and avoids the walk from the public garage. Is there any separate late check-in fee?
Correct. The difference is $12.47, and Midtown Lodge lists no late check-in fee. The quoted $421.64 is the full lodging total with parking for both nights.
Then replace the Hampton with Midtown Lodge. Book one room for my wife and me, add the same 12:30 to 1:00 a.m. arrival note, and cancel the Hampton while its deadline is still open.

Midtown Lodge Raleigh is booked for two adults from Friday, November 14 through Sunday, November 16, at a refundable total of $421.64 including taxes and on-site parking. The reservation is guaranteed for arrival between 12:30 and 1:00 a.m. Saturday; confirmation MLR-582041. Free cancellation ends at 6:00 p.m. local time Thursday, November 13. Hampton confirmation RHM-731946 has been canceled with no penalty; cancellation reference HCX-90428.
